title: Photon Orbits Across Kerr Alternate Universes
content: We develop a self-contained, analytic classification of all null geodesics in the exterior and interior regions of the Kerr spacetime, with particular attention to photon trajectories that traverse the ring singularity neighbourhood and re-emerge into topologically distinct asymptotic regions of the maximally extended spacetime. Starting from Carter's complete separation of the null geodesic equations in Boyer--Lindquist coordinates, we parameterize every orbit by the impact parameters $\xi = L/E$ and $\eta = K/E^{2}$. Introducing $\sigma = \cos^{2}\!\theta$ as a squared-cosine variable, we derive explicit roots $\sigma_{\pm}(\xi,\eta)$ of the angular potential and use them to partition the $(\xi,\eta)$ plane into four dynamically distinct regimes. For each regime we provide closed-form angular integrals in terms of complete and incomplete elliptic integrals of Legendre type. We state and prove a complete classification theorem, identifying the precise conditions on $(\xi,\eta)$ that determine: equatorial crossing, hemisphere confinement, singularity encounter, and the integer half-libration count $J$ that governs alternate-universe transit. The analysis is supplemented by a computation of the Lyapunov exponent of the unstable spherical photon orbit.
